title: Composite Samples & Staged Rollout Runbook for SDK/API Features (Function Calling, Structured Output, Streaming)
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Purpose: Produce a single, coherent set of composite sample apps and a staged rollout runbook that demonstrates function calling, structured output, and streaming across Redwood SDKs (JS/Python/Go) and the REST API. These artifacts will be the canonical examples used in release notes, quickstarts, sample kits, and partner enablement. Scope: - Composite sample apps: chat assistant (streaming + function calling), document QA (structured output + embeddings), and real-time summarizer (streaming + structured output). Each sample must include: language SDKs (JS/Python/Go), Dockerized local run instructions, and a minimal server-side example for webhooks. - Runbook: staged rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%), rollback criteria, telemetry events to validate quality (latency P95, error rate, hallucination rate via eval hooks), communication templates for support and customer success. - Release notes coordination: canonical blurb + platform migration notes, breaking-change checklist, and deprecation guidance for older sample endpoints. Out of scope: full end-to-end localization of all sample text (we will localize README and user-facing strings for EN/ES/DE only in the initial wave). Key constraints and trade-offs: - Time: cross-team alignment window is 3 weeks. We prioritize reproducible samples over exhaustive language coverage. - Backward compatibility: samples should continue to support legacy SDK surface where feasible; where not, include a clear migration section. - Telemetry: lightweight events to avoid adding perf noise, but must capture sample success/failure. Success criteria: - Composite samples published under samples.redwood.ai with README, runnable Docker, and tests. - Runbook validated in one internal pilot and signed off by Eng, DX, and Support. - Release notes approved and ready by release cut date (sdk-2025.03 freeze).
acceptance_criteria: Three composite sample apps (chat assistant, document QA, real-time summarizer) each with JS/Python/Go SDK examples
Automated smoke tests for each sample that run in CI and validate core flows (function call invoked, structured JSON produced, streaming chunk order preserved)
Staged rollout runbook with explicit canary metrics, rollback thresholds, and communications templates
Release notes paragraph plus migration guide and API changelog entries
Telemetry schema (events + metrics) documented and shipped to observability team
